shortTitle: Global Inequities in Precision Medicine Research in Annals of Epidemiology
longTitle: A Large Language Model Analysis of Global Inequities in Precision Medicine Research on Diabetes
summary: Through the use of an annotated dataset, prompt engineering, and GPT4o, we showed that there are significant disproportionalities in the representation of populations from Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Sub-Saharan Africa in precision medicine research for diabetes.
citation: Soniwala A., Kim S. et.al. A Large Language Model Analysis of Global Inequities in Precision Medicine Research on Diabetes. Annals of Epidemiology. 2025. 109:25-30. doi:10.1016/j.annepidem.2025.06.021
